settings.name: USE_MTLS
settings.description: **Use mutual TLS:** Enable client certificate authentication for the current site.

settings.name: MTLS_CA_CERTIFICATE_PRIORITY
settings.description: **Client CA bundle priority:** Source of the client CA bundle: `file` (path) or `data` (base64/PEM).

settings.name: MTLS_CA_CERTIFICATE
settings.description: **Client CA bundle path:** Path to the trusted client CA bundle (PEM), readable by the Scheduler. Required when `MTLS_VERIFY_CLIENT` is `on` or `optional`.

settings.name: MTLS_CA_CERTIFICATE_DATA
settings.description: **Client CA bundle data:** Trusted client CA bundle supplied directly as base64 or plaintext PEM (e.g. through the web UI).

settings.name: MTLS_VERIFY_CLIENT
settings.description: **Verify client mode:** Choose whether certificates are required (`on`), optional (`optional`), or accepted without CA validation (`optional_no_ca`).

settings.name: MTLS_URL
settings.description: **mTLS URL:** Regex matched against the request URI to enforce a valid client certificate only on matching paths (HTTP only). Requires `MTLS_VERIFY_CLIENT` set to `optional` or `optional_no_ca`. Leave empty to enforce mTLS on the whole site.

settings.name: MTLS_VERIFY_DEPTH
settings.description: **Verify depth:** Maximum certificate chain depth accepted for client certificates.

settings.name: MTLS_FORWARD_CLIENT_HEADERS
settings.description: **Forward client headers:** Propagate verification results (`X-SSL-Client-*` headers with status, DN, issuer, serial, fingerprint, validity window). Client-supplied `X-SSL-*` headers are always stripped on ingress, so these values cannot be spoofed.

settings.name: MTLS_CRL_PRIORITY
settings.description: **Client CRL priority:** Source of the CRL: `file` (path) or `data` (base64/PEM).

settings.name: MTLS_CRL
settings.description: **Client CRL path:** Optional path to a PEM-encoded certificate revocation list, readable by the Scheduler. Applied only when the CA bundle is successfully loaded. nginx requires the CRL file to contain a CRL for every CA in the verification chain.

settings.name: MTLS_CRL_DATA
settings.description: **Client CRL data:** Certificate revocation list supplied directly as base64 or plaintext PEM.
